CENSUS_SRC: 2,546,118 in the 2024 census (UBOS), up from 2,061,694 in 2014
MLD_SRC: Proclaimed by UNESCO; observed every year
QUOTE: At UNESCO in 1960, Amadou Hampâté Bâ of Mali said of the keepers of oral tradition: “I consider the death of each of these traditionalists as the burning of an unexploited cultural fund.” It is often summed up as: when an old man dies, a library burns. MyCulture is one way to write down, with their consent, what the elders of Lango choose to hand on.
QUOTE_SRC: Amadou Hampâté Bâ, UNESCO General Conference, 1 December 1960, as rendered in the UNESCO Courier. The “library” wording is a later popular paraphrase of his words.
POLICY: Since 2007, Uganda’s thematic curriculum has provided for teaching the early primary grades in the local language of the area. Teachers and parents in Lango need good, trusted material in Leb Lango. MyCulture can become one source of it, once Lango language experts have checked it. It is for people aged 13 and over today; a version for schools would need its own safeguards and your advice first.
POLICY_SRC: National Curriculum Development Centre (NCDC). The lower-primary curriculum is under review.
